objective: Add backward-compatible persistence foundations for reservation identity/members, movement lifecycle, snapshot provenance and capacity constraint staging without cutting over R4-R7 runtime semantics.
invariants: R3 is additive and backward compatible.
R3 does not infer historical reservation identity from person_name.
R3 does not classify historical movements as PROGRAMADO.
R3 does not remove the historical 132 capacity fallback; that belongs to R4.
R3 does not change current capacity calculations.
R3 does not enforce closure immutability; that belongs to R7.
R3 does not delete or rewrite historical rows.
reservation_members identity must survive replacement of the current workers table.
No reservation_members foreign key to workers is allowed.
Existing legacy data must remain explicitly unresolved where canonical information is unavailable.

reservation_members.workers_fk: FORBIDDEN because workers is replaceable operational state
reservation_members.security: RLS enabled; anon/authenticated receive no direct table access

movements.historical_rule: Existing movements must not be inferred as PROGRAMADO

daily_snapshots.legacy_rule: Existing snapshots remain LEGACY_UNRESOLVED or nullable; no provenance may be fabricated
daily_snapshots.future_rule: R4 new closures must write provenance V1 before Capacity V1 is accepted

daily_capacity.deployment_form: CHECK constraint staged NOT VALID before explicit validation

rules.title: reservation member identity is canonical and durable
rules.requirement: reservation_members must contain reservation_id + canonical rut, unique(reservation_id,rut), reference reservations(id), and must not FK to workers.

rules.title: reservation_members is security-safe
rules.requirement: RLS must be enabled and anon/authenticated direct access revoked or otherwise denied.

rules.title: movement lifecycle foundation exists
rules.requirement: movements gains lifecycle_status supporting PROGRAMADO, EJECUTADO, CANCELADO and LEGACY_UNRESOLVED.

rules.title: movement lifecycle is legacy-safe
rules.requirement: executed_at/cancelled_at foundations exist and historical rows are never inferred to PROGRAMADO.

rules.title: snapshot provenance V1 foundation exists
rules.requirement: daily_snapshots gains capacity source, operational universe count/fingerprint, source import, operational revision and semantic/provenance version fields.

rules.title: snapshot provenance is legacy-safe
rules.requirement: Existing snapshots remain unresolved/nullable and migration performs no guessed provenance backfill.

rules.title: daily capacity nonnegative constraint is staged
rules.requirement: daily_capacity receives CHECK(capacity >= 0) using staged NOT VALID rollout.

rules.title: R3 schema release is expand-only
rules.requirement: R3 must not DROP/TRUNCATE/DELETE/RENAME business structures or perform destructive legacy transformations.

rules.title: Capacity V1 remains outside R3
rules.requirement: The existing daily_capacity_default/132 runtime fallback remains untouched until R4.

rules.title: R2 quality and HTTP semantics remain intact
rules.requirement: The removed EXPECTED_BEDS=504 business assumption stays absent and HTTP 504 retry semantics stay present.

rules.title: R3 migration is auditable and rollback-classified
rules.requirement: The R3 migration must explicitly declare EXPAND scope and rollback classification and contain no runtime cutover.
